reviews.text: Melissa and Mark at Shutter Shop were so easy to work with.  They came out quickly to measure and get me a competitive quote.  They explained all the various options for what kind of shutters I wanted.  They kept me updated as the manufacturer built the shutters, and worked with me to take down our existing blinds before installing the new shutters. I ran into Mark coming out of a house across the street from ours and I called him over to measure our windows and provide a quote since we just moved in. Melissa and Mark came out with samples a few days later so we could see how each sample looked in the home. We were very pleased working with them and coming up with the right products for our house. A friend recommended that I reach out to Shutter Shop for the window treatments that I was in need of. I stopped in the showroom and met with Melissa, the designer. She was helpful with making recommendations while staying within my budget range.  I would highly recommend shutter shop to anyone needing window treatments.
